title: The quiet Canva Magic Studio habit behind every good result
caption:
The quiet Canva Magic Studio habit behind every good result

Audit yourself against this:
1️⃣ Build the master carousel — Design once at 1080×1350 — every other platform size derives from this one file.
2️⃣ Magic Resize everything — One click → IG, LinkedIn, X, story formats. On-brand, no re-layout, no cropping surprises.
3️⃣ Lock the Brand Kit — Fonts, colors, and logos locked so nothing ships off-brand at 2 AM on a posting streak.
4️⃣ Sheet → 10 posts — Bulk create turns one column of tips into 10 finished carousels — the batch-day multiplier.
